tools.name: chaosx_blender_hoi4_health
tools.description: Verify the locked Blender executable, addon, and job boundary.

tools.name: chaosx_blender_hoi4_prepare_candidate
tools.description:
Prepare a candidate; optional output_namespace_rel isolates all fixed outputs.

    All sources must lie inside that existing child, with no previous checkpoints.
    Pass input paths relative to the registered job; returned worker artifact paths
    are relative to the explicitly returned output_namespace_rel.

tools.name: chaosx_blender_hoi4_inspect_scene
tools.description: Inspect a checkpoint; optional hash-bound mesh_region or action-channel inventory remains read-only.

tools.name: chaosx_blender_hoi4_review_humanoid_components
tools.description: Catalog loose source-index components and render bounded labelled group evidence without changing the Blend.

tools.name: chaosx_blender_hoi4_process_textures
tools.description: Extract textures, or relink approved DDS maps in a bounded saved scene.

tools.name: chaosx_blender_hoi4_bake_static_mesh_transforms
tools.description: Bake transforms for approved static-building working meshes only.

tools.name: chaosx_blender_hoi4_inspect_mesh_winding
tools.description: Read hashed source-index and exact-position winding diagnostics without mutation.

tools.name: chaosx_blender_hoi4_repair_mesh_winding
tools.description: Preserve geometry/weights/actions and correct only proven coherent component orientation.

tools.name: chaosx_blender_hoi4_inspect_fitted_humanoid_source
tools.description: Inspect exact world vertices/topology of one hashed existing humanoid source.

tools.name: chaosx_blender_hoi4_author_fitted_humanoid_rig
tools.description: Apply explicitly measured bones/weights from a SHA-bound declarative spec.

tools.name: chaosx_blender_hoi4_author_fitted_humanoid_action
tools.description: Author and bake explicit role keys on an existing fitted skeletal rig.

tools.name: chaosx_blender_hoi4_partition_skeletal_mesh_export_batches
tools.description: Partition a hashed existing skeletal source using identical material copies only. Reconcile image-user additions only from transaction-created equivalent clones on exact owned mesh slots; image content, original consumers, and retention remain exact.

tools.name: chaosx_blender_hoi4_partition_static_mesh_export_batches
tools.description: Partition a static building into bounded material-backed PDX mesh streams.

tools.name: chaosx_blender_hoi4_promote_accepted_reimport
tools.description:
Copy one hash-bound animated reimport proof with metadata-only working approval.

    Require its complete receipt and immutable source .blend/.mesh/.anim hashes,
    one exact rig and 1-512 exact meshes, and a new sibling checkpoint. Preserve
    geometry, materials, weights, bones, actions and scale through save/reopen.
    This does not import actions, author geometry, convert or approve exports.

tools.name: chaosx_blender_hoi4_author_locator
tools.description:
Create/update one job-owned bone-parented Empty, never geometry or motion.

    Supply a measured bone-head-local position in checkpoint units and a unit
    quaternion in x,y,z,w order (Blender axes). The exact rig/bone must exist.
    The output must be a new .blend beside the input checkpoint; existing or
    foreign locator names, parents, and checkpoint outputs are rejected.

tools.name: chaosx_blender_hoi4_export_mesh
tools.description: Export the approved collection through io_pdx_mesh.

tools.name: chaosx_blender_hoi4_export_animation
tools.description: Export one audited Blender action through io_pdx_mesh.

tools.name: chaosx_blender_hoi4_import_animation_action
tools.description:
Transfer one receipt-verified provider/professional skeletal action by its exact source id.

    Source ids may include balanced parenthetical qualifiers used by ordinary FBX action names.
    The destination action remains a separately validated safe runtime identifier.

tools.name: chaosx_blender_hoi4_retime_animation_action
tools.description: Retime one verified-source action without changing or replacing its skeletal motion.

tools.name: chaosx_blender_hoi4_author_locomotion_action
tools.description: Author and checkpoint an in-place locomotion action on the approved rig.

tools.name: chaosx_blender_hoi4_author_humanoid_rig
tools.description: Create the bounded HOI4 24-bone humanoid rig on approved geometry.

tools.name: chaosx_blender_hoi4_patch_existing_humanoid_action_phases
tools.description: Clone an existing action and apply explicit authorized manual bone-phase keys in a new sibling; no geometry edits or semantic approval. Reopen receipts prove exact image content and consumers; all image datablocks and packed bytes remain exact, allowing only consumer release caused by accepted removed orphan materials.

tools.name: chaosx_blender_hoi4_author_humanoid_actions
tools.description: Author humanoid actions, optionally preserving a fused two-hand weapon grip.

tools.name: chaosx_blender_hoi4_segment_creature_components
tools.description: Split a nonhumanoid candidate into loose, rider-region, or semantic spatial components.

tools.name: chaosx_blender_hoi4_calibrate_creature_scale
tools.description: Scale a creature and rider together so the rider matches the measured infantry runtime height.

tools.name: chaosx_blender_hoi4_inspect_mesh_landmarks
tools.description: Write a bounded hash-bound rest-vertex/bone inventory; return compact file evidence only.

tools.name: chaosx_blender_hoi4_repair_explicit_skin
tools.description: Repair exact reviewed vertex weights; preserve all other fingerprints and reopen proof.

tools.name: chaosx_blender_hoi4_preview_explicit_skin_selection
tools.description: Read-only exact source-index rest-mesh highlight; red full faces, cyan mixed boundary.

tools.name: chaosx_blender_hoi4_author_measured_creature_rig
tools.description:
Author explicit measured bones and ordered spatial weights on a new sibling checkpoint.

    rig_spec keys: name, bones [{name,parent,head,tail,roll_degrees?,deform?}],
    weight_regions [{name,min,max,bones,rigid}], body_triangle_target (0 disables),
    repair_boundaries (boolean). World-space coordinates; first matching region.

tools.name: chaosx_blender_hoi4_attach_rigid_component
tools.description:
Add explicit closed triangular component geometry rigidly bound to one existing bone.

    component_spec: name, bone, material (existing working material), vertices
    (world coordinates), triangles (indices), loop_uvs (one UV per face corner).
    All source meshes are preserved and total triangles may not exceed ceiling.

tools.name: chaosx_blender_hoi4_author_measured_creature_action
tools.description:
Create a new explicit articulated action from caller-authored phases; no canned motion.

    action_spec: name, role, fps, frame_start, frame_end, loop, root_bone,
    ground_contact (per_frame_lowest_point_1mm or none), phases [{name,frame}],
    keys {bone:[{frame,rotation_degrees:[x,y,z],location:[x,y,z]}]}.
    Rotations are absolute local XYZ Euler degrees converted to quaternions.
    Keys must include every phase; unlisted bones use identity. Source actions
    are retained, new actions require semantic/deformation review and reimport.

tools.name: chaosx_blender_hoi4_author_creature_rig
tools.description: Create and checkpoint a bounded custom rig for a nonhumanoid creature candidate.

tools.name: chaosx_blender_hoi4_author_creature_action
tools.description: Author one real skeletal creature action and checkpoint its contact-checked result.

tools.name: chaosx_blender_hoi4_correct_action_grounding
tools.description: Apply bounded root/contact correction to a verified-source action; never replace body motion.

tools.name: chaosx_blender_hoi4_import_bvh_animation_action
tools.description: Native-import and retarget one receipt-verified professional BVH action.

tools.name: chaosx_blender_hoi4_prepare_export_coordinate_checkpoint
tools.description: Checkpoint one accepted action in the existing PDX export coordinate system.

tools.name: chaosx_blender_hoi4_offset_action_root
tools.description: Apply one bounded root-location offset to an existing action frame range.

tools.name: chaosx_blender_hoi4_sanitize_runtime_candidate
tools.description: Create a runtime checkpoint; weight_only preserves geometry, rig, weapons, and materials.

tools.name: chaosx_blender_hoi4_reimport_export
tools.description: Reimport exported PDX assets and save proof into the job.

tools.name: chaosx_blender_hoi4_save_checkpoint
tools.description: Copy a verified checkpoint to a named stage without changing source data.

tools.name: chaosx_blender_hoi4_repair_explicit_mesh_winding_batch
tools.description: Flip only hash-bound per-mesh face lists in one new sibling; exact preconditions, full scene proof and <=0.5 degree native/reopen normals.

tools.name: chaosx_blender_hoi4_repair_explicit_skin_batch
tools.description: Replace only exact hash-bound per-mesh expected/replacement weight records; one immutable-source sibling transaction, positive normalized <=4 influences.

tools.name: chaosx_blender_hoi4_replace_explicit_corner_normals
tools.description: Replace explicit mesh/face/corner/vertex unit directions with expected-before proof; preserve every unselected raw/decoded corner exactly in one new sibling.

tools.name: chaosx_blender_hoi4_repair_explicit_mesh_winding
tools.description: Flip an exact reviewed face list in a new hash-bound sibling; preserve corners, weights, rig and actions.

tools.name: chaosx_blender_hoi4_ground_existing_action
tools.description: Copy one reviewed skeletal action and correct true-root location in pure world Z.

tools.name: chaosx_blender_hoi4_repair_explicit_mesh_patch
tools.description: Apply an exact reviewed local face/vertex patch; no inferred fill, rig replacement or source overwrite.

tools.name: chaosx_blender_hoi4_edit_explicit_mesh_vertices
tools.description: Apply exact world positions/normalized existing deform-bone weights; verify readback and save/reopen.

tools.name: chaosx_blender_hoi4_bind_existing_pdx_material
tools.description: Bind unique hash-bound PDX maps to exact existing slots; preserve source materials and mesh/rig/actions.

tools.name: chaosx_blender_hoi4_repair_explicit_vertex_remap
tools.description: Exact source-vertex fan copies/coincident aliases with explicit corner remaps; no inferred weld or weights.

tools.name: chaosx_blender_hoi4_rotate_existing_assembly_yaw
tools.description: Rigid cardinal working-assembly yaw with every requested action frame verified; protected source objects excluded.

tools.name: chaosx_blender_hoi4_collapse_identity_leaf_joints
tools.description: Collapse only constant-identity leaves into direct parents, proving all-frame skin/action/locator preservation.

tools.name: chaosx_blender_hoi4_inspect_animation_source
tools.description: Read standalone FBX skeleton/action identity in a disposable scene without a target checkpoint.
